PRESS RELEASE Shadowfax to Acquire WeFast, Marking Its Entry into India’s Fast-Growing On-Demand Intra-City Logistics The deal opens a major new growth engine in on-demand intra-city goods transportation and brings enterprise-grade logistics to India’s SMEs and consumers Bengaluru, 24th November 2026: Shadowfax Technologies Limited today announced the acquisition of WeFast (Borzo India) for ₹23.3 crore. The deal marks Shadowfax’s entry into on-demand intra-city goods transportation, one of India’s largest logistics markets and one that is formalising fast. It also opens a significant new growth engine, extending Shadowfax’s services to small and medium businesses (SMEs) and customer-to-customer (C2C) deliveries. Founded in Mumbai in 2016, WeFast has earned a loyal following among small businesses and C2C users who count on it to move goods across their city quickly and reliably. It now operates in 5+ cities, where 32k+ delivery partners complete over 1.2 crore deliveries a year, and it generated roughly ₹200 crore in adjusted revenue in CY2025. Strategic Rationale for the Acquisition • A large market at the start of its digital shift: Intra-city goods transportation is one of India’s largest logistics markets, with vast headroom for digital adoption as it moves beyond local tempo operators and informal couriers. SMEs and C2C users are embracing online platforms for transparent pricing, on-demand vehicles and real-time tracking, and the organised segment is growing at over 50% a year. • Bringing enterprise-grade logistics to SMEs and C2C users: Through WeFast’s app, shop owners, distributors and individual users get the same reliability and technology that India’s largest platforms get from Shadowfax. They can book two-, three- and four-wheelers on demand for urgent intra-city deliveries, with upfront pricing and live tracking. • Building on a proven playbook with Shadowfax 360: Launched in FY26, Shadowfax 360 opened the company’s express parcel network to SMEs and D2C brands and crossed 6,700 transacting sellers within two quarters. Transfer of Tubes Business of the Company and entering into Business Transfer Agreement between the Company and APL Apollo Tubes Limited Considered and approved the transfer of the business of manufacturing, processing, marketing, sale and distribution of steel tubes and pipes at and from the steel tubes manufacturing facilities of the Company at Jamshedpur, Hosur, Khopoli and Sahibabad, in each case, including products manufactured directly by the Company or through contract manufacturing arrangements, and certain cold rolling and surface coated steel product facilities at Khopoli, together with all related plants, facilities, operations and activities ancillary or incidental thereto (‘Tubes Business’) of the Company to APL Apollo Tubes Limited (‘APL Apollo’), as a going concern on a slump sale basis for a lump sum consideration of up to ₹11,700 crore. Towards this, the Board also considered and approved the Business Transfer Agreement (‘BTA’) to be entered into between the Company and APL Apollo. The transaction is subject to customary conditions precedent, including approval from Regulatory Authorities as may be necessary. For further details refer to Annexure 1. 2. Divestment of entire equity stake in Tata Steel Colors Private Limited The Company directly holds 43,30,00,000 equity shares representing 50% equity stake in its wholly owned subsidiary Tata Steel Colors Private Limited (formerly known as Tata BlueScope Steel Private Limited) (‘TSCL’). The Company, indirectly through its another wholly owned subsidiary, Tata Steel Downstream Products Limited (‘TSDPL’), holds the balance 43,30,00,000 equity shares representing the remaining 50% equity stake in TSCL. The Board of the Company at its meeting held today, considered and approved the sale and transfer of its entire equity stake of 100% (held directly or indirectly through one of its wholly owned subsidiaries, TSDPL), in its wholly owned subsidiary, TSCL, to APL Apollo, for a consideration of ₹16,300 crore. The Board also considered and approved the Share Purchase Agreement to be entered into between the Company, TSCL, TSDPL and APL Apollo, pursuant to which each of the Company and TSDPL will sell their entire shareholding in TSCL to APL Apollo for an aggregate consideration of ₹16,300 crore. Upon consummation of the transactions contemplated under the Share Purchase Agreement (‘SPA’), 100% of the total paid up equity share capital of TSCL will be owned by APL Apollo. The transaction is subject to customary conditions precedent, including approval from Regulatory Authorities as may be necessary. Post this transaction, TSCL will cease to be a subsidiary of the Company. For further details on this transaction, please refer to Annexure 2.
